name: Notes
tagline: Quick notes and ideas, kept private on your box.
description: Notes is a fast place to jot down thoughts, lists and links from any device. Notes are plain text with simple formatting and stay on your box. It is built on Memos, a free and open-source note-taking app.
whatsNew: Installs on your box with saved files, live status and start and stop controls. Finish account setup when you first open the app.
